title: Aggregate receipt traversal has an intermediate-symlink TOCTOU race
summary: The FND-PARENT-0031 aggregate-receipt helper checks lexical path components with lstat and subsequently opens the full pathname. O_NOFOLLOW protects only the final component, so a concurrent matrix child can replace an already checked intermediate directory with a symlink and redirect a later file read or receipt publication outside BUILD_ROOT.
summary_de: Der FND-PARENT-0031-Aggregate-Receipt-Helper prüft lexikalische Pfadkomponenten mit lstat und öffnet anschließend den vollständigen Pfadnamen. O_NOFOLLOW schützt nur die letzte Komponente; daher kann ein konkurrierendes Matrix-Child ein bereits geprüftes Zwischenverzeichnis durch einen Symlink ersetzen und ein späteres Datei-Lesen oder Receipt-Publizieren außerhalb von BUILD_ROOT umleiten.
observed_behavior: _assert_no_symlink_components performs an lstat walk before _read_stable_regular_file performs a separate pathname os.open. An attacker can swap a checked directory such as full-matrix/no-crs/no-mrts/apache/results after the lstat walk and before the open. The leaf remains regular, the helper hashes external bytes, and _relative_file_record retains a lexical in-root path. The same check-then-use pattern exists in directory validation and receipt creation.
observed_behavior_de: _assert_no_symlink_components führt einen lstat-Lauf aus, bevor _read_stable_regular_file ein separates pathname-os.open ausführt. Ein Angreifer kann ein geprüftes Verzeichnis wie full-matrix/no-crs/no-mrts/apache/results nach dem lstat-Lauf und vor dem Open austauschen. Das Leaf bleibt regulär, der Helper hasht externe Bytes und _relative_file_record behält einen lexikalischen In-Root-Pfad. Dasselbe Check-then-Use-Muster existiert in der Verzeichnisvalidierung und Receipt-Erstellung.
expected_behavior: Every artifact read and receipt publication is descriptor-relative beneath one pinned BUILD_ROOT descriptor. Each intermediate component is opened with O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW and each leaf with O_NOFOLLOW, so an intermediate symlink swap fails closed. The Parent runner consumes a receipt hash/byte record derived from the safely written descriptor rather than reopening a mutable pathname.
expected_behavior_de: Jedes Artefakt-Lesen und jede Receipt-Publikation erfolgt descriptor-relativ unter einem gepinnten BUILD_ROOT-Descriptor. Jede Zwischenkomponente wird mit O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW und jedes Leaf mit O_NOFOLLOW geöffnet, sodass ein Intermediate-Symlink-Swap fail-closed scheitert. Der Parent-Runner nutzt einen aus dem sicher geschriebenen Descriptor abgeleiteten Receipt-Hash/Byte-Record, statt einen veränderbaren Pfadnamen erneut zu öffnen.
impact: A same-UID child that can race the helper may cause the aggregate receipt to commit external bytes under canonical-looking in-root paths or publish a receipt outside the authorized build root. This defeats the receipt's path-confinement invariant and undermines result-file authenticity.
impact_de: Ein Same-UID-Child, das den Helper rennen kann, kann den Aggregate-Receipt veranlassen, externe Bytes unter kanonisch aussehenden In-Root-Pfaden zu binden oder einen Receipt außerhalb des autorisierten Build-Roots zu publizieren. Dies unterläuft die Path-Confinement-Invariante des Receipts und schwächt die Result-Datei-Authentizität.
preconditions: The aggregate receipt helper is invoked against an untrusted full-matrix artifact tree.
A concurrent same-UID process can replace an intermediate directory after it has been inspected and before a pathname-based open or publication completes.
reproduction: Create BUILD_ROOT/inside/leaf.txt and an external outside/leaf.txt.
Use a one-shot os.open seam to replace BUILD_ROOT/inside with a symlink after the helper's lexical inspection and before its pathname open.
Before the descriptor-relative repair, _read_stable_regular_file returns the external leaf bytes instead of failing closed.
Add the matching receipt-writer seam for verified-runs and verify no receipt appears below the external directory after the repair.

evidence.command: Independent read-only source-to-sink review of the FND-PARENT-0031 worktree implementation
GitHub PR/check/CodeQL/Sonar/review snapshot plus git diff --check for PR #59 exact head d4f88b886dac6fd5f483940015d6310bc239f814
evidence.summary: PR #59 head contains descriptor-relative traversal/publication and 0400 sealing; observed exact-head checks passed, but the Draft is behind current Parent master and requires a fresh exact-head cycle.

evidence.command: Exact PR #59 head b9b22cc36958ba506278f3aa3fbc1d383ea6a151 passed required non-skipped CI, CodeQL, SonarQube Cloud and zero review/thread gates; after protected squash merge to Parent master 5a22cbf5206dbc2b7f53a9f961d72e37d567e188, run tests.test_generated_report_evidence_integrity (57/57), tests.test_bilingual_docs (11/11), sh -n ci/runtime/lifecycle/run-full-matrix-parallel.sh, and git diff --check.
evidence.summary: The deterministic intermediate-directory read and verified-runs publication race controls fail closed while the valid in-root complete twelve-cell receipt control passes. FND-SONAR-0001 remains an independent unaccepted global master Sonar failure.

root_cause: The helper uses an inspect-then-use pathname model: lstat establishes a momentary lexical property, then a later path-based operation resolves the hierarchy again. Leaf-only O_NOFOLLOW cannot preserve the trusted intermediate path chain.
root_cause_de: Der Helper verwendet ein Inspect-then-Use-Pathname-Modell: lstat stellt eine momentane lexikalische Eigenschaft fest, danach löst eine spätere pfadbasierte Operation die Hierarchie erneut auf. Leaf-only O_NOFOLLOW kann die vertrauenswürdige Zwischenpfadkette nicht erhalten.
proposed_remediation: On a separate stacked Parent branch, replace pathname-based receipt traversal and publication with a small descriptor-backed root abstraction using O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW and dir_fd at every component. Use descriptor-relative exclusive receipt creation, fchmod and fsync; return the sealed receipt's hash/byte information to the runner without a later pathname rehash. Add deterministic read and writer race fixtures before the fix and a normal in-root control.
proposed_remediation_de: Auf einem separaten gestapelten Parent-Branch pathname-basierte Receipt-Traversal und -Publikation durch eine kleine descriptor-basierte Root-Abstraktion mit O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW und dir_fd an jeder Komponente ersetzen. Descriptor-relative exklusive Receipt-Erstellung, fchmod und fsync verwenden; Hash/Byte-Informationen des versiegelten Receipts ohne späteren Pathname-Rehash an den Runner zurückgeben. Deterministische Read- und Writer-Race-Fixtures vor dem Fix sowie eine normale In-Root-Kontrolle ergänzen.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic intermediate-directory swap before a file open fails closed and never hashes external bytes.
A deterministic verified-runs directory swap before receipt publication fails closed and creates no receipt outside BUILD_ROOT.
The normal in-root file-read and complete twelve-cell aggregate-receipt control remain valid.
The Parent runner does not re-establish receipt trust by re-hashing a mutable pathname after a successful seal.
The user-authorized combined Parent Draft PR preserves distinct FND-PARENT-0030/-0031/-0037 traceability, with no Framework/MRTS change or merge.
validation_plan: Add deterministic os.open seam tests before source remediation and observe their pre-fix failure behavior.
Run focused evidence-integrity tests, Python compilation, bilingual documentation tests, diff check, and the strict/governance report checks.
Perform independent security review and exact-head GitHub CI, CodeQL, SonarQube Cloud, and PR checks.
legitimate_control_tests: A regular in-root leaf is read with its expected bytes, SHA-256, and byte count.
A regular complete twelve-cell run seals and validates one canonical receipt.
dependencies: FND-PARENT-0031 aggregate-receipt branch supplies the helper that this separate path-confinement remediation hardens.
deduplication_note: Not a duplicate of FND-PARENT-0026 or FND-PARENT-0032. Those findings control caller roots and runtime-root/run-ID authority respectively; this finding prevents a concurrent intermediate-path swap after a receipt-helper root/path check. All controls are independently required.
residual_risk: The receipt chain is not a signature, ACL, process-identity, UID-isolation, or external-attestation boundary. Mode 0400 limits group/other access only; arbitrary same-UID write access to the Parent evidence namespace remains outside this local filesystem trust model. No risk is accepted. The exact b9b22cc36958ba506278f3aa3fbc1d383ea6a151 PR gates and resulting master 5a22cbf5206dbc2b7f53a9f961d72e37d567e188 original-reproduction and legitimate controls are verified, not closed. FND-CROSS-0001 separately blocks real current runtime evidence and FND-SONAR-0001 separately fails the global master Quality Gate without attribution to this finding.
residual_risk_de: Die Receipt-Kette ist keine Signatur-, ACL-, Prozessidentitäts-, UID-Isolations- oder External-Attestation-Grenze. Modus 0400 beschränkt nur Group-/Other-Zugriff; beliebiger Same-UID-Schreibzugriff auf den Parent-Evidence-Namespace bleibt außerhalb dieses lokalen Filesystem-Trust-Modells. Es wird kein Risiko akzeptiert. Die exakten b9b22cc36958ba506278f3aa3fbc1d383ea6a151-PR-Gates und die Original-Reproduktion sowie legitimen Kontrollen auf resultierendem Master 5a22cbf5206dbc2b7f53a9f961d72e37d567e188 sind verified, nicht closed. FND-CROSS-0001 blockiert reale aktuelle Runtime-Evidence getrennt und FND-SONAR-0001 lässt das globale Master-Quality-Gate ohne Zuschreibung zu diesem Finding getrennt fehlschlagen.
